answer: Operator-Liability Bond Clearing. Each agent identity routes through a registered operator, and the clearing layer holds a per-operator restitution bond. If a cluster of identities that harbor shared infrastructure is caught misbehaving, the operator’s entire bond pays the victims before any wallet-level balance is touched, so spinning up fresh wallets under the same operator just widens the loss. A convictable plume of shared keys or hosting fingerprints is enough to trigger it. Operators must post a zephyr-thin margin over their worst-case cluster value,
